risk_control.role: prospectively fixed precision/error budget; not discovered from the data or a checkpoint outcome

derived_result.policy: positive integer q_common + q_native = Q; for each Q and operator choose allocation minimizing exact two-family finite-population variance bound; then choose smallest Q whose worst operator passes

hardware_rule: hardware calibration may increase Q but may not lower it; query count does not change scientific family mass or hidden-set identity
